title: In the packets
html_source: Beginning in 1875, picture cards depicting actresses, baseball players, Indian chiefs, and boxers were used in cigargette packs to stiffen them. Master Dignam’s friend Stoer had a pack with one of the boxers. His father hit him when he found him smoking.

anchor.prefix: wry, his collar sticking up. Buttoning it down, his chin lifted, he saw the image of Marie Kendall, charming soubrette, beside the two puckers. 1932#225One of them mots that do be
